999008199.text: 頼まれていた高性能望遠鏡、船に搭載しておいたわ

localizations.en: I've had the high-powered telescope you asked for installed on the ship.

999008199.text: おっ、できたのね！　助かる～！

localizations.en: Oh, it's ready? That's a lifesaver!

999008199.text:
九偉人図で目安となる星の位置や方角を割り出せても、
現地で確認できなければ意味がないもの

localizations.en: We can use the Portraits of the Nine to determine star positions and directions, but that's meaningless if we can't confirm them on-site.

999008199.text:
そうなのよね。暗黒の氷海はそれこそ空が暗いし、
星をちゃんと見られるか不安だものね

localizations.en: Exactly. The Midnight Sea lives up to its name—the sky's dark up there. I wasn't sure we'd even be able to see the stars properly.

999008199.text:
ワルターは人造頂獣で社会貢献してるし、
元錬金党、随分頑張ってるじゃない？

localizations.en: Walther's out there making a difference with the man-made Apexi... the former Polar Night Alchemists have really come a long way, haven't they?

999008199.text: あら、おほめにあずかり光栄ね

ご褒美……ってわけじゃないけど、
ちょうど来てたから紹介するわ

localizations.en: It's not exactly a reward, but since you're here—there's someone I'd like you to meet.

999008199.text: 彼女が極夜の錬金党、党首か……

localizations.en: So this is the leader of the Polar Night Alchemists...

999008199.text:
諸島同盟監察官のエルス・マーティン。
あんたに興味があるんだって

localizations.en: Els Martin, inspector for the Archipelago Federation. She says she's interested in you.

999008199.text: よろしく頼む

まあ、素敵な美人。鏑矢や千歳といい、
無数島群域もなかなかやるわね……

localizations.en: My, what a stunning woman. Between her and Kaburaya and Chitose... the Infinite Island Chain certainly doesn't disappoint.

999008199.text:
ふふ、私に興味があるのなら、
今度じっくりと私のことを教えてあげるわ

localizations.en: Hehe. If you're interested in me, I'd be more than happy to tell you everything about myself sometime.

999008199.text:
ぜひ、色々と教えてもらおう。
不審な態度があれば、問答無用で拘束させてもらうが

localizations.en: I'll take you up on that. Though if I detect anything suspicious, I won't hesitate to detain you.

999008199.text:
あなたのような美人に拘束されるなら、悪くないかも
……なんて、冗談よ。睨まないで

localizations.en: Being detained by someone as lovely as you... doesn't sound so bad. ...That was a joke. Please stop glaring at me.

999008199.text: あー、二人とも、そこまでにしてもらって

localizations.en: Alright, you two, that's enough of that.

999008199.text:
（一族の因縁とか抜きにしても、クリセルダを
　キューンたち妹には会わせたくなくなってきたわ）

localizations.en: (Family history aside... I'm starting to think I'd rather not introduce Criselda to Quinn and the others.)

999008199.text:
ヴァレリア、私こう見えて
あなたたちには感謝しているのよ

localizations.en: Valeria, whatever I may look like—I am genuinely grateful to all of you.

999008199.text: えっ……？
こうして、世界のまだ見ぬ美女と邂逅させてくれるもの

localizations.en: You keep introducing me to beautiful women I never would have met otherwise.

999008199.text: あ、そういうこと……

今回の旅の成功……あなたの渇望が満たされることを
祈っているわ

localizations.en: I'm praying for the success of this journey—and that whatever it is you're searching for, you find it.

999008199.text:
誰一人欠けずに無事に戻って来ることを、
願っているぞ

localizations.en: Come back safe. All of you—every last one.

999008199.text: うん……二人とも、ありがとう！
